headline: Prop sector leads volatility as A plunges 32.0% over five days and PF drops 20.00% intraday.
market_take: Today's coverage shows mixed direction across sectors, with the property space delivering the sharpest swings both down and up. Food stocks displayed notable price‑gap alerts, including a -100.00% open gap for CHOTI, while PF&REIT saw several high‑sigma volume spikes. Conservative and construction names such as PLE and SOLAR posted solid intraday gains, offset by heavy volume alerts in CONMAT and regulatory filings in CONS.

SST rose +5.26% and NRF +4.76% while KSL dropped -5.58%; CHOTI opened with a -100.00% gap and PRG recorded a 3.1σ volume spike.
PLE surged +16.67% intraday despite low volume; SOLAR added +3.85% and TTCL posted the biggest 5‑day gain at +33.3%.
SSTRT and FTREIT logged volume spikes of 5.8σ and 3.2σ respectively; SSPF rose +4.17% and CPTREIT disclosed a capital reduction.
DCON experienced a -6.67% open gap; DCC saw an extreme 77.3σ volume spike.
